description: Integration wiring to connect supply_chain_enrichment.py to signal_analyser_v2.py. Calls signal_analyser_v2 via ws_execute to register the enrichment as a new signal source. Updates mcp_signal_enrichments with supply_chain_enrichment records via ws_write. Uses write_service at :8772 for all DB operations. Follows inter-daemon communication rule — no HTTP between peers. Verifies enrichment produces >=20 distinct scores across 34 fingerprints before activating.
